title: Service Term Commitment and Cancellation Terms of the Line Extension Agreement (Line Extensions and New Service Construction)
content:
The line extension agreement a member signs with Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative under **Line Extensions and New Service Construction** carries three terms that differ, or could differ, by class of extension: the service term, the treatment of the engineering design fee on cancellation, and the period within which cancellation refunds are made.

## Terms by class

| Class of extension | Service term at the location | Design fee kept when the member cancels | Cancellation refund period |
|---|---|---|---|
| Permanent Residential Overhead Extension | 0 months (no term) | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Permanent Residential Underground Extension | 0 months (no term) | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Seasonal Residence Extension | 60 months | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Farm and Ranch Extension | 0 months (no term) | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Irrigation Well Extension | 60 months | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Three-Phase Commercial Extension | 60 months | Yes | 30 calendar days |
| Temporary Construction Service | 0 months (no term) | Yes | 30 calendar days |

## Meaning of each term

- **Service term** — the number of months the member agrees to take service at the location, with any shortfall billed on early termination. Three classes carry a 60-month term (five years): the Seasonal Residence Extension, the Irrigation Well Extension and the Three-Phase Commercial Extension. A figure of 0 means the agreement carries no service term.
- **Design fee kept on cancellation** — Yes in every class: when the member cancels, the engineering design fee is kept by the cooperative.
- **Cancellation refund period** — the 30 calendar days within which payments beyond costs incurred are refunded after a cancellation.
